title: Attractive and functional
text: Attractive and functional. This is a very attractive and functional storage container. I use it to keep my whole coffee beans fresh for a couple of weeks, storage prior to daily grinding. One drawback - the airtight seal is a little weak. I think it's almost airtight, maybe fully, but it's not a tight seal so I'm not sure.

product_metadata.title: Siwanamu Coffee Canister, Airtight Stainless Steel Food Storage Container with Date Tracker, Brush and Scoop for Beans and Grounds, Flour, Sugar, 22OZ, Black
features: ☕Track Freshness of Your Coffee -- This opaque airtight container for coffee features a numerical day and month tracker so that you always know how fresh your coffee is.
☕Functioning Coffee Storage -- This one-way valve allows carbon dioxide to escape and makes this coffee storage airtight canister the best vessel to extend your coffee’s shelf life.

☕Airtight Storage Container -- The container comes with a high-quality BPA-free rubber seal lid. This is an ideal container for dry goods, food, ground coffee beans, tea, flour, sugar, and herbs, etc.
☕Great on Your Kitchen Counter -- This aesthetically appealing food canister in neutral black color will further elevate the décor of your kitchen while reflecting your elegant taste.

☕Package Includes -- Siwanamu canister with scoop we include for free a coffee brush with comfortable round handle and long-lasting bristles that will help you brush away the coffee ground residue. Moreover,the three valves are also included.
